headline: Merz–Weidel Generaldebatte after Sachsen-Anhalt; Android Sep patch enables remote privilege escalation without taps; Brent briefly clears $100.

stories.title: Merz vs Weidel: Generaldebatte after Sachsen-Anhalt

facts.text: tagesschau liveblog (Wed): three days after AfD’s Sachsen-Anhalt win, AfD chief Weidel opens the Bundestag Generaldebatte; Chancellor Merz answers in the Elefantenrunde on the 2027 budget week.
Weidel: coalition “unseriöse Haushaltsführung,” planned new borrowing “beispiellos,” draft “verfassungswidrig”; paints deindustrialization / energy-crisis picture and pushes cheap Russian gas.
Merz: AfD is a “destruktive Kraft”; calls AfD “Remigration” “nichts anderes als eine ethnische Säuberung nach Hautfarbe und Herkunft”; says AfD won’t win absolute majorities elsewhere.
Bundestagspräsidentin Klöckner warns AfD benches (“nicht auf dem Fußballplatz”) and threatens ejection amid interruptions; SPD’s Miersch urges democrats not to “zerlegen” each other.
Greens’ Dröge renews call to examine an AfD ban procedure; debate still running into early afternoon.

stories.whyItMatters: First full Merz–Weidel clash in the chamber after the CDU’s Sachsen-Anhalt rout — sets the tone for budget week and coalition reform fights.

stories.title: Android Sep patch: critical remote privilege escalation, no user tap

facts.text: heise on Google’s mid-September Android Security Bulletin: >90 fixed issues — 26 critical, 68 high — across Framework, Kernel, and System on Android 14–17 (incl. 16-qpr2).
Worst Framework/System bugs: remote privilege escalation without extra execution rights and without user interaction (Google). Patch levels 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-05.
Some fixes ship via Play services; most need OEM OTA. Pixel/Samsung starting rollouts; Motorola/Xiaomi/Oppo/Nothing often slower. Google: no known in-the-wild abuse yet.
Golem same window: frames the bug class as remote device takeover without Nutzerinteraktion.

stories.whyItMatters: Classic “install now” month — zero-interaction remote EoP is the kind of bulletin that should bump patch SLAs on fleets still lagging OEM OTAs.

stories.title: Brent briefly clears $100 after overnight tanker escalation

facts.text: Guardian / dpa-AFX (Wed): Brent clears $100 for the first time since late July — Guardian notes ~+2.1% through the milestone; Börsennews: early trade peak ~$100.19 (+~2.3%).
Tied to overnight Centcom tanker strikes + Iran’s Jordan/Hormuz claims (morning lead) and Houthi attacks on Saudi cities/energy sites.
Europe gas also jumps: Dutch TTF ~+4% to €78.73/MWh (highest since Jan 2023); UK contract highest since Dec 2022 (Guardian).
BoE’s Bailey (Tue, via Guardian): oil-driven inflation risks “on the upside.” Brent ~+25% since early August; >60% YTD.

stories.whyItMatters: Material market follow-through on this morning’s tanker/Hormuz story — energy inflation back on the midday tape.

NASA Curiosity blog: rover marks 5,000 sols (~5,137 Earth days) + >1 km climb from Gale floor; studying “Chocolatal” ripple.
ESA: MTG-I2 reaches final GEO (~36,000 km); commissioning starts for Europe/N. Africa weather imaging.
UK ATC update (SPIEGEL): Tue ~1,300 cancellations; Wed morning already +177 more (mostly Heathrow) — airlines demand consequences as recovery crawls.
